name: vqa
description: The visual prove engine's CLI, bound to two harness checks (visual-qa.literal): a build capture proved against a cuespec whose thresholds were scouted from the reference (vqa.literal-diff), and the engine's own calibration on planted defects (vqa.planted-defect). The evidence folder holds capture.png, its capture.json and cuespec.json.

evidence.description: The run's evidence folder: capture.png, capture.json, cuespec.json

vqa.literal-diff.description: Every cue matches: exit 0 matches, 1 a failed or partial verdict

vqa.planted-defect.description: Every detector catches every planted defect with no false fire; writes only to the system's temporary folder
